flags.scanned: matches_cached (live_matches_cached) is above zero AND prematch.last_scan_age_sec (live.last_scan_age_sec) is not null, for the mode on screen
flags.scan_completed: last_scan_age_sec (live.last_scan_age_sec) is not null for the mode on screen, whether the completed scan read any matches or none
flags.unverified_links: unverified_links (live_unverified_links) is above zero, for the mode on screen
flags.verified_groups: match_groups on /api/results for the mode on screen, which is the same count as the health endpoint's verified_groups but read per mode
flags.have_surebets: the surebets the /api/results payload returned, as held in allSurebets
flags.show_surebets: shownSurebets: the count left after the client's own filters, so at most have_surebets

group_statuses: Deliberately not rendered. `group_matches` returns only the groups the certainty gate accepted, so the match report it feeds never holds a `suggested` or `rejected` entry and group_statuses can only be {} or {"verified": n}. Printing a count of verified groups next to a sentence about refused pairings would read as though the refusals had been counted too.

cases.title: Ready to Hunt Surebets
cases.body: Click Scan Now to start scanning your connected bookmakers for arbitrage opportunities. Browser windows will open — solve any CAPTCHA if prompted.
cases.body_live: Click Scan Now to scan all bookmakers for in-play arbitrage opportunities. Live odds change fast — rescan often.
cases.title_bs: Spremno za lov na sigurne dobitke
cases.body_bs: Kliknite Skeniraj sada da započnete skeniranje povezanih knjiga za arbitražne prilike. Otvorit će se prozori preglednika — riješite CAPTCHA ako se pojavi.
cases.body_live_bs: Kliknite Skeniraj sada da skenirate sve knjige za in-play arbitražne prilike. Kvote uživo se brzo mijenjaju — skenirajte često.

cases.title: No Matches — The Scan Read Nothing
cases.title_live: No Live Matches — The Scan Read Nothing
cases.body: The scan finished, but every connected bookmaker returned no matches for this feed. A book that could not be read is left out of the scan rather than filled with stale prices, so this is a feed result, not a filter result. Check the per-book status and any error on the health bar, then scan again. This is not a filter problem: no market, bookmaker or minimum profit can create a match the books did not publish.
cases.body_live: The live scan finished, but every connected bookmaker returned no in-play matches. A book that could not be read is left out of the scan rather than filled with stale prices, so this is a feed result, not a filter result. Check the per-book status and any error on the health bar, then scan again. This is not a filter problem: no market, bookmaker or minimum profit can create a match the books did not publish.
cases.title_bs: Nema utakmica — skeniranje nije pročitalo ništa
cases.title_live_bs: Nema utakmica uživo — skeniranje nije pročitalo ništa
cases.body_bs: Skeniranje je završeno, ali nijedna povezana kladionica nije vratila utakmice za ovaj feed. Knjiga koja se nije mogla pročitati izostavljena je iz skeniranja umjesto da bude popunjena zastarjelim kvotama, pa je ovo rezultat feeda, a ne filtera. Provjerite status po knjigama i eventualnu grešku na health traci, pa skenirajte ponovo. Ovo nije problem filtera: nijedno tržište, knjiga ni minimalni profit ne mogu stvoriti utakmicu koju knjige nisu objavile.
cases.body_live_bs: Skeniranje uživo je završeno, ali nijedna povezana kladionica nije vratila in-play utakmice. Knjiga koja se nije mogla pročitati izostavljena je iz skeniranja umjesto da bude popunjena zastarjelim kvotama, pa je ovo rezultat feeda, a ne filtera. Provjerite status po knjigama i eventualnu grešku na health traci, pa skenirajte ponovo. Ovo nije problem filtera: nijedno tržište, knjiga ni minimalni profit ne mogu stvoriti utakmicu koju knjige nisu objavile.

cases.title: No Surebets — Deep Links Are Unproven
cases.body: The scan read {matches} matches. {unverified_links} of them carry a per-event link that has never been proven, and the certainty gate refuses a pairing the moment one side's link is unproven, so a match on that list can never join a verified group. {verified_groups} match groups came out verified, which leaves the surebet engine with nothing to price. This is not a filter problem: no market, bookmaker or minimum profit can prove a link. The pairings the gate refused are queued in the Review tab.
cases.title_bs: Nema sigurnih dobitaka — duboki linkovi nisu dokazani
cases.body_bs: Skeniranje je pročitalo {matches} utakmica. {unverified_links} ih nosi link po događaju koji nikada nije dokazan, a gate sigurnosti odbija par čim je link jedne strane nedokazan, pa utakmica s tog popisa nikada ne može u potvrđenu grupu. {verified_groups} grupa utakmica je potvrđeno, što surebet engine ostavlja bez ičega za obračun. Ovo nije problem filtera: nijedno tržište, knjiga ni minimalni profit ne mogu dokazati link. Parovi koje je gate odbio su u redu za pregled.

cases.title: No Surebets — No Match Group Is Verified
cases.body: The scan read {matches} matches. {unverified_links} of them are carrying an unproven per-event link, and {verified_groups} match groups came out verified, so nothing reached the surebet engine: it is only ever fed groups the certainty gate has proven to be the same event — the same league (or the exact same two teams under a differently-named league), kickoff within 15 minutes, the same match category, the same two teams in the same home/away order, and each side's link either proven or declared absent. The pairings the gate refused are queued in the Review tab. This is not a filter problem: no threshold or market choice can prove that two fixtures are the same event.
cases.title_bs: Nema sigurnih dobitaka — nijedna grupa utakmica nije potvrđena
cases.body_bs: Skeniranje je pročitalo {matches} utakmica. {unverified_links} ih nosi nedokazan link po događaju, a {verified_groups} grupa utakmica je potvrđeno, pa ništa nije stiglo do surebet enginea: on prima samo grupe koje je gate sigurnosti dokazao kao isti događaj — ista liga (ili ista dva tima pod drugim nazivom lige), početak unutar 15 minuta, ista kategorija utakmice, ista dva tima u istom redoslijedu domaćin/gost, i link svake strane dokazan ili deklarisan kao odsutan. Parovi koje je gate odbio su u redu za pregled. Ovo nije problem filtera: nijedan prag ni izbor tržišta ne mogu dokazati da su dvije utakmice isti događaj.

cases.title: No Surebets — Verified Groups, Nothing Priced
cases.body: The scan proved {verified_groups} match groups, so pairing worked, and the surebet engine priced none of them. A group is only priced once its kickoff has not passed and its odds are still inside the freshness window the health bar reports, so a group already under way — or a scan older than that window — is never priced at all. This is not a filter problem: this scan priced no surebet at the {profit_floor_percent}% floor it applies, so there is nothing for the filters to reveal. Scan again for a fresher read of the same fixtures.
cases.title_bs: Nema sigurnih dobitaka — potvrđene grupe, ništa obračunato
cases.body_bs: Skeniranje je dokazalo {verified_groups} grupa utakmica, pa je uparivanje radilo, a surebet engine nije obračunao nijednu. Grupa se obračunava samo ako joj početak nije prošao i kvote su još unutar prozora svježine koji prikazuje health bar, pa se grupa koja je već počela — ili skeniranje starije od tog prozora — nikada ne obračunava. Ovo nije problem filtera: ovo skeniranje nije obračunalo nijedan siguran dobitak na pragu od {profit_floor_percent}% koji primjenjuje, pa filteri nemaju šta otkriti. Skenirajte ponovno za svježiji prikaz istih utakmica.

cases.title: No Surebets Match Your Filters
cases.body: The scan priced {surebets} surebets and the filters in force are showing none of them. Every control on this bar is applied on top of the scan, so the market, the bookmakers, the search text and the minimum profit can each hide all of them. The certainty gate is not involved here — the scan already priced these.
cases.title_bs: Nema sigurnih dobitaka koji odgovaraju filterima
cases.body_bs: Skeniranje je obračunalo {surebets} sigurnih dobitaka, a aktivni filteri ne prikazuju nijedan. Svaki kontrol na ovoj traci se primjenjuje nakon skeniranja, pa tržište, knjige, tekst pretrage i minimalni profit mogu sakriti sve. Gate sigurnosti ovdje nije uključen — skeniranje ih je već obračunalo.
